claim: Hook (PICK A): 'Katanya pakai AI harus langganan bulanan. Ternyata sekarang bisa isi saldo, kayak pulsa.' OCTA Token has no monthly subscription; balance-based, drawn down as used; payable with pulsa. (Framed as paid multi-model access; caption notes many AI apps have free tiers.)
Telkomsel launched OCTA Token on 23 November 2026 (press event, Telkomsel Smart Office, Jakarta)

One OCTA balance gives access to 'puluhan' (dozens of) AI models from providers incl. OpenAI, Google, Anthropic and DeepSeek; captions attribute the counts: media (CNBC/CNN) say 69, Telkomsel's Aris Sudewo quoted (CNN) 'lebih dari 85'
numbers: spoken/on screen: 'puluhan' (no number); captions: 69 per CNBC/CNN, >85 per Telkomsel (CNN quote)

claim: Packages are Rp100.000, Rp250.000 and Rp500.000, tax included (tax only in captions)
Each package includes a 500 MB data bonus valid 30 days (captions only)
Priced/paid in rupiah; payment via pulsa, Halo bill, QRIS, e-wallets, bank services
Token balance has no expiry ('OCTA Token itu tidak berbatas waktu, jadi tidak ada expired date-nya', Aris Sudewo, Telkomsel)
Bought in the MyTelkomsel app, for Simpati and Telkomsel Halo customers; used at octa.telkomsel.com (login with Telkomsel number + SMS OTP)
No per-prompt price or rupiah-to-token rate has been published ('belum disebut'); cost depends on the model chosen and how often it is used
Caption: 'Bukan iklan, tidak disponsori' (our own statement; Rangkumin Dong has no deal with Telkomsel)
